hints.title: Consecutive Pairs
hints.text: The input list contains pairs of [freq, val] at indices [2*i, 2*i + 1].

hints.title: Step by Two
hints.text: Iterate i by steps of 2. In each step, extract freq = nums[i] and val = nums[i + 1].

hints.title: Append Freq Copies
hints.text: Append val to the result array exactly freq times.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: M: total sum of all freq elements (length of decompressed array)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: There is no shortcut faster than outputting each decoded element.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-allocating or extending arrays operates in linear time in the output size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate strides index by 2 and constructs decompressed output without off-by-one errors.
complexity.notes: nums has even length between 2 and 100.
